items.rationale: Optional glazing peril 2.1(e) is agreed; drilling is a preparatory operation within glazing work (1.3, 2.7.2), so it is covered at a modest market price.

items.description: Installation of the new glass into the frame
items.rationale: Setting and fitting the pane is part of glazing work indemnified in its entirety under 2.7.2 where the peril is agreed; priced as ordinary fitting labour.
A cabinet door pane is a glazing element (1.3) and its breakage is covered under 2.7.1 with the glazing option agreed; like-for-like pane at a fair market price (7.1.10).
One attendance per undertaking is payable in full under 2.7.2 and 7.1.12 because indemnified glazing work was done at the visit; references suggest a low price level for this line.
